column1: # US Navy hulls in commission by the dataset's unit type, as the Naval Vessel Register lists them.
# unit_type: the ForceAssetId the order of battle counts them under. hull: the hull number. name: the name as the register prints it.
# class: the class the register files the hull under (its lead hull). source: the register's page. opened: the day it was read.
# The register (site updated 2026-08-11) lists 83 cruisers and destroyers against the 90 surface combatants the order of battle counts,
# 47 active attack submarines against 49, and 31 amphibious ships and 11 carriers, as counted. Littoral combat ships and ballistic-missile
# submarines are left out: no force package sends them. A hull lost past the end of a class's names is lost by class alone.
